name: Gas Prices
overview: Scripture warns against placing trust in wealth, teaching that those who rely on riches will ultimately fall, while the righteous will thrive. Wisdom includes prudent stewardship of resources, as seen in the value of saving rather than foolishly spending. Believers are cautioned not to labor merely to gain riches or serve money, since one cannot serve both God and wealth. Instead, Christians are called to seek treasures in heaven rather than earthly possessions that are subject to decay and loss.
